|lore=<nowiki/>'''Dejarik''' of a Ng’ok war beast. Foul temper gives rise to bad feelings. Has razor-sharp retractable claws. Used in many systems to frighten off potential attackers.
|game_text=Deploy on table. If your character, starship, or vehicle in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). [Immune to Alter]

This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Ng'ok War Beast (Virtual Set 1, Original)]] (version 3 of 3); it is the current text. Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' ([[Ng'ok War Beast (Virtual Set 1, Original)]]): Players Committee 2014 Virtual Set 1 preview<ref name="eh1351-ngok-0">[https://www.scribd.com/document/248870122/Star-Wars-CCG-Virtual-Card-Expansion-Set-1 Players Committee, 2014 Virtual Set 1 preview, p. 1 (public mirror)].</ref>. Dated 2014 (Set 1 preview); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was this version of Ng'ok War Beast (Virtual Set 1, Original) first published|section=On what day were the early Virtual Modern card versions first published?}} Text: “Deploy on table. If your character in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). [Immune to Alter]” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Ng'ok War Beast]]): Players Committee Official Errata list<ref name="eh1351-ngok-1">[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1dXwBAYCUyBvWHpZc-oSCedmOZUb5f9vSDzUdvV2dUTY/export?format=csv Players Committee, Official Errata list, 16 December 2015].</ref>. First published 16 December 2015. Text: “Deploy on table. If your character, starship, or vehicle in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' game text: new or changed words “, starship, or vehicle”; the printed errata mark is now “E” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-ngok-2">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/ngokwarbeast.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ca1ccff62ff30b7e29da803f91a6d09ab542d803 commit ca1ccff] (3 October 2022).</ref>. First published 3 October 2022. Text: “Deploy on table. If your character, starship, or vehicle in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' the words are the same: the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “E”); the margin title lost its uniqueness dot. It prints the errata mark “E1”. This is the current text.

|rulings=* The text 'if forfeited, forfeit for 0' means that a substituted forfeit value of 0 is applied. This cannot be circumvented by cards such as [[Sacrifice]].<ref name="scomp">Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json official Dark card data], record 1689, rulings.</ref>
* If a hit character is excluded from battle (e.g. by [[Clash Of Sabers]]), the character is excluded, then automatically lost due to being hit outside of battle. [[Ng'ok War Beast]] does not protect a character in that situation.
